dedupe_keys.name: armenia health and healthcare statistical yearbook national institute of health statistical data tables charts and maps on health services and population health

description: This yearbook is Armenia's official annual compendium of health and healthcare statistics, compiled by the National Institute of Health under the Ministry of Health. Each edition gathers statistical data, tables, charts and maps on the health of the population and on the health system, broken down by region (marz), and the 2026 edition carries data up to 2025. The yearbook page links two PDF files and states that an English version is available alongside the Armenian one. It is free to download from the institute's reports and yearbooks section, where earlier editions and other reports are also listed. Caveats: the PDFs are page layouts, not data files, the Armenian text in the 2026 file is stored as glyph names so tables cannot be copied out as text, no licence is stated, and the exact table list of each edition was not read here. Coverage is national with regional breakdowns. Simulation uses: baseline hospital, bed and workforce figures by region for health system capacity and resilience studies in Armenia, and a check on international series for the country.
